title: The final duel
description: The character of Anakin Skywalker was portrayed by actor Sebastian Shaw as an older man in Return of the Jedi, both in his death scene and in "Force spirit" form during the movie's finale. In the prequels, it is Hayden Christensen who assumes the role in younger form. So to maintain continuity, recent DVDs of Jedi have been altered so that Skywalker's ghost appears as a young man, again played by Hayden Christensen. Lucas reasoned that Anakin has learned to control his life force beyond death, just as Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda had before him. So he is therefore able to return to the young man he once was before turning to the dark side.
